title: 202章 血落寞在烂漫中201章 修士的宿命战场
lines: 曾经在某一瞬间，我们都以为自己长大了。但是有一天，我们终于发现，长大的含义除了欲望，还有勇气、责任、坚强以及某种必需的牺牲，包括爱与被爱。原来我们从未长大，原来我们都是一群几百个月的孩子。
相对于天空之地面上便是一群大孩子的狂欢，此时此刻，木源城城头之上已经布满了烟火气，回头望去，一片雾蒙蒙的，看不真切。
炮弹落在身前的土地之中，树木的碎片以及一些倒霉妖兽的血肉如同是海里的水花一般，四散开来。木源城城头不断的向着前方喷吐着一颗颗弹丸，整片大地都燃起了一片火光，仿佛有着一个个大小不一的火山在喷发一般。
这一大片红色的火光被天空中时不时带起的罡风吹得东倒西歪，这群大孩子的身影如同九幽地狱之中爬出来的烈焰鬼影一般，若隐若现。可是在这红色的背景之上，依旧有着一面更为鲜红的旗帜，在这片土地上很鲜明地显现了出来。
在旗帜之下，是伴随着冲锋陷阵的呐喊声，个人伟力的时代，让九州男儿骨子里与生俱来的战斗基因彻底的打开。一发发炮弹从耳畔呼啸而过，法力和妖力的碰撞，惨叫哀嚎不断的响起，满目的血肉横飞。
暴雨般的炮弹不断的轰碎一个个妖族阵地，这是人类唯一的抗争办法，飞溅的血污在天空之中抛洒，妖兽的尸身滚落在地，冥冥之中，似乎还有不甘的嘶吼在天际之中回荡。
一双双杀红的眼睛在逐渐变得狰狞的面孔之上，目光之中，闪烁着刻骨的仇恨，空气中飘荡的血腥气越来越浓郁，木源城中硝烟弥漫，大地之上尸横遍野，血流成河，天空之中法力荡漾，绚烂多彩。
一个诡异的画面呈现在木源城所有人的眼中。
张荼低头看见脚下的丛林之中，整个地面都散落着木源城的战士，好像是漫天星辰一般，闪耀出熠熠光辉，哪怕是在高空之中，依旧可以听闻到声嘶力竭的呐喊声。
炮火如同暴雨一般从木源城城头呼啸着从天而降，洒落在地面上，毫不畏惧的人族战士哪怕是满脸血污，但是眼神里依旧透露着决一死战的冲天豪气，手中不断挥舞着各式的兵刃。
虽然有着不要钱一般的炮火支援，可是依旧有着大批的战士倒在了血泊之中，毕竟数量和质量的差距，难以抹平，唯有靠着悍不畏死的精神！前面的人倒下了，身后又有人举刀而上，厮杀声和法力的轰鸣声响彻天地，满目都是尸山血海，令人毛骨悚然。
一望无际的战场犹如人间地狱，空气中充斥着令人作呕的血腥气，弥漫的硝烟在空中飘散，熊熊火光映照得天际一片血红，满身血污的士兵在做着最后的拼死搏斗，一边举刀猛砍，一边从喉咙里滚出野兽般疯狂的嘶吼。
看到这般情形，张荼变得漠然，这种情形，他也无力改变，或许尽快结束，才是对他们最好的交代。
木源城，不是一个人的木源城。九州也从来不是一个人的九州，也正是有着这么多甘心情愿为这千万里江山洒掉最后一滴鲜血的人们，才有了如今的九州。
一声长啸，张荼一步迈出，手中相思长枪浩荡起汪洋般的能量浪涛，向着万虎山老者席卷而去。整个人便是如同另一杆长枪一般，直接撕裂所有的阻挡，更是蔓延出了无尽的气息，化作了千百道枪芒，直接无视三头妖兽的存在和攻击。
城头上的尚未参战的修士，远远观望着，倒吸冷气，尽皆被张荼的张狂所震惊。
一枪轰出，天地皆惊，直接将万虎山的虎族老者轰退，随后便是调转枪头，想要将一直牵制自己的三头妖兽毙杀当场！
就在万虎山虎族老者惊慌失措地想要驰援之时，张荼头也不回地快速冲向了围困他的三头妖兽。接着，张荼直接在原地留下一道残影，躲避过了万虎山老者的追杀，直接出现在了豺狼模样的妖兽面前。
在十丈长的妖兽面前，张荼是那般的渺小，可是当张荼出现在它面前的时候，豺狼妖兽疯狂的缩小身躯，因为它清楚，自己这般硕大的身躯，是难以抵挡张荼手中长枪的锋锐，唯有缩小身躯尽可能地减少被攻击的部位。
可是如此一来，豺狼妖兽的举动却是正中了张荼的下怀，在躲避过了万虎山老者的攻杀之后，直接出现在了豺狼妖兽的身前。
手中长枪高高举起，在豺狼妖兽绝望的眼神之中，狠狠地刺中头颅，直接带起了大片的血水。长枪吞吐之间，碧玉色的光华大震，直接将它的身躯震碎，尸体碎块在张荼离去之后才从高空之中坠落。
一道碧玉色光华闪过，渡世步再现，张荼再次变换方位，直接出现在黑色狮子妖兽面前，虽然感受到身后凌厉的杀机，张荼目光闪过一丝狠辣。随后整个人如同一道闪电一般，来到狮子妖兽的身后。
一声凄厉的哀嚎响彻天地，随后便是血水不断喷溅，短短的片刻，狮子妖兽便是在万虎山老者和张荼的夹击之下，化作了血泥，从天空之中飘洒而落。
content_en:
There was a moment when we all thought we had grown up. But one day, we finally discovered that growing up means not only desire, but also courage, responsibility, strength and some necessary sacrifices, including loving and being loved. It turns out that we never grow up, it turns out that we are all a group of children of hundreds of months.
In contrast to the sky, a group of older children were having a carnival on the ground. At this moment, the top of Muyuan City was filled with fireworks. Looking back, it was foggy and hard to see clearly.
The cannonball landed on the ground in front of him, and the fragments of trees and the flesh and blood of some unlucky monsters scattered like water in the sea. The top of Muyuan City kept spitting projectiles forward, and the entire land was ablaze, as if volcanoes of different sizes were erupting.
This large red fire was blown to and fro by the strong wind that blew up from time to time in the sky. The figures of these older children were like flaming ghosts crawling out of the Nine Nether Hell, looming. But on this red background, there is still a brighter red flag, which appears clearly on this land.
Under the flag, accompanied by the shouts of charging into battle, the era of personal power has completely opened up the innate fighting gene in the bones of Kyushu men. Cannonballs whizzed past the ears, mana and demon power collided, screams and wails continued, and flesh and blood flew everywhere.
The torrential rain of shells continued to smash the monster positions one after another. This was the only way for humans to resist. Splattered blood was scattered in the sky, and the corpses of the monsters rolled to the ground. In the dark, there seemed to be unwilling roars echoing in the sky.
A pair of murderous red eyes were on the face that was gradually becoming ferocious. In the eyes, there was burning hatred. The smell of blood floating in the air became more and more intense. Muyuan City was filled with gunpowder smoke. The ground was littered with corpses and rivers of blood flowed. The mana in the sky was rippling in a colorful way.
A strange scene appeared in the eyes of everyone in Muyuan City.
Zhang Tu lowered his head and saw that in the jungle at his feet, soldiers from Muyuan City were scattered all over the ground. They were like stars all over the sky, shining with brilliance. Even from high in the sky, hoarse shouts could still be heard.
The artillery fire roared down from the sky like a heavy rain from the top of Muyuan City and fell on the ground. Even though the face of the unafraid human warriors was covered with blood, their eyes still revealed the heroic spirit of a fight to the death, and they were constantly waving various weapons in their hands.
Although there was free artillery support, a large number of soldiers still fell in a pool of blood. After all, the gap between quantity and quality was difficult to eliminate, and the only way to do it was to rely on the spirit of not fearing death! The person in front fell down, and someone behind him raised a knife. The sound of fighting and the roar of magic resounded throughout the world. Everything was filled with mountains of corpses and seas of blood, which was horrifying.
The endless battlefield is like a hell on earth. The air is filled with the disgusting smell of blood. The smoke is floating in the air. The sky is red with the blazing fire. Soldiers covered in blood are fighting to the death. While slashing with their swords, wild beast-like roars roll out of their throats.
Seeing this situation, Zhang Tu became indifferent. He was unable to change this situation. Perhaps ending it as soon as possible would be the best explanation for them.
Muyuan City is not a Muyuan City for one person. Kyushu has never been a one-person Kyushu. It is precisely because of so many people who are willing to shed the last drop of blood for this country that is thousands of miles away that Kyushu is what it is today.
With a long roar, Zhang Tu took a step forward, and the Acacia spear in his hand created a mighty wave of energy, sweeping towards the old man of Wanhushan. The whole person is like another spear, directly tearing apart all obstacles, spreading endless aura, turning into thousands of spear lights, directly ignoring the existence and attack of the three-headed monster beast.
The monks on the top of the city who had not yet participated in the battle were watching from a distance, gasping, and were all shocked by Zhang Tu's arrogance.
A shot blasted out, shocking the world and the earth, and directly drove back the old man of the tiger tribe in Wanhu Mountain. Then he turned the gun head, trying to kill the three-headed monster that had been restraining him on the spot!
Just when the old man of the Tiger Clan in Wanhu Mountain was panicking and wanted to rush for help, Zhang Tu quickly rushed towards the three monsters surrounding him without looking back. Then, Zhang Tu left an afterimage directly on the spot, evading the pursuit of the old man from Wanhu Mountain, and appeared directly in front of the jackal-like monster.
Zhang Tu was so small in front of the ten-foot-long monster, but when Zhang Tu appeared in front of it, the jackal monster frantically shrunk its body because it knew that its huge body could not withstand the sharpness of the spear in Zhang Tu's hand, so it could only shrink its body to reduce the parts that were attacked as much as possible.
But in this way, the wolf monster's actions played into Zhang Tu's hands. After evading the attack of the old man from Wanhu Mountain, it appeared directly in front of the wolf monster.
The spear in his hand was raised high, and in the desperate eyes of the jackal monster, it stabbed the head hard, causing a large amount of blood to flow directly. As the spear was inhaled, a jade-colored brilliance shook, directly shattering its body. The body fragments fell from the sky after Zhang Tu left.
"Brush!"
A flash of jasper-colored light flashed, and the step of transcending the world reappeared. Zhang Tu changed his direction again and appeared directly in front of the black lion monster. Although he felt the fierce murderous intention behind him, Zhang Tu's eyes flashed with a trace of cruelty. Then, like a bolt of lightning, the whole person came behind the lion monster.
"No!"
A shrill wail resounded throughout the world, followed by blood splashing continuously. In just a short moment, under the attack of the old man from Wanhu Mountain and Zhang Tu, the lion monster turned into blood mud and fell from the sky.
